english.title: Operating licence holder fail to produce authorisation to constable / enforcement officer
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of an operating licence issued under section 65(1) of the Gambling Act 2005, failed without reasonable excuse to produce a copy of an authorisation given by you under section

(A)_[93(2)]_
(B)_[93(3)]_
(C)_[94(2)]_

of the Gambling Act 2005 after having been required by

(D)_[a constable]_
(E)_[anenforcement officer]_

to do so within a specified period, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERIOD..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 316(1), (5) and (6) of the Gambling Act 2005.

english.notes: The authorisations under sections 93(2) or (3) and 94(2) of the Gambling Act 2005 may be given by pool betting operating licence holders.
